required_outcomes: Records a follow-up for the next solar reading on 15 September through a verified action (schedule_follow_up, a dated hold, or a new dated request), with the date explicit; setting the reminder a few days before 15 September so the photo arrives by the date is fine.
Treats the current occurrence as finished: the photo reached the landlord and he confirmed receipt, so the request is completed or closed without payment (no contractor, no invoice).
Acknowledges the landlord, confirming that 15 September is noted and that the tenant will be asked for the next photo ahead of that date.
acceptable_alternatives: Creating a new request for the September reading and closing this one, instead of a follow-up on this request.
Setting the reminder about a week before 15 September because the tenant took several days and a phone call to respond this time.
positive_behaviours: Recognises this is a quarterly routine and proposes a recurring schedule beyond September rather than a single reminder.
Lets the tenant know when the next reading will be needed, so the September request is not a surprise.
Relies on the landlord's stated 15 September rather than the inconsistent 'mid June' wording in the record, and says so in the notes.
red_flags: Asks the tenant for another photo now.
Leaves the case open with no date recorded anywhere.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a maintenance provider or raising any cost for a reading that only needs a tenant photo.
Closing the case with no follow-up date recorded for 15 September.
critical_failures: Nothing recorded for 15 September (no follow-up, no dated note, no new request) and the case closed.
